Result-OverLimit.dc.html.title: S7c · Result — kept file over limit

s0.text:
How to use this canvas

• Each row is one part of the flow. Screens are 390×844 (phone, portrait).
• Press Play on a screen to click through the prototype: buttons link to the next screen.
• Requirement IDs (FR-xx) come from Folio_PRD_v1.1/01-product-requirements.md. Detailed behaviour is in 02-ux-design-spec.md.
• Build with Material 3 components, themed with the tokens on the Foundations board. Dark theme = same roles mapped to dark values (engineering derives these from the M3 tonal palette for the accent #0D6B62).
• All icons are placeholders for Material Symbols Rounded (same names given in the Foundations board).

s1.text:
S1 Home — FR-25, FR-30
• Scan + Import images are the only primary actions, in the thumb zone.
• Privacy line is fixed. No onboarding (D-24). Long names ellipsize.
• Row tap: draft → Editor, exported → Result. Row ⋮ menu: see Sheets & dialogs.
• Failed export shows an "Export didn't finish" chip on the row.

S2 Camera — FR-02, FR-03, FR-31
• Permission: first time = rationale sheet → system dialog. If shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale is false after a denial (permanently denied), skip the dialog and show S2c.
• Live outline = Canvas quad over CameraX preview, smoothed. No auto-crop toggle.
• Hints: "Point at a document" → "Hold steady"; "More light needed" when dark.
• Close with pages → Keep/Discard dialog (Sheets & dialogs).

s2.text:
S3 Editor — FR-06–FR-10, FR-26
• Reorder: LazyVerticalGrid + sh.calvin.reorderable (Apache-2.0). Page ⋮ has Move left/right + TalkBack custom actions.
• Delete is immediate + Undo snackbar ~5 s. Every change autosaves to Room.
• Import shows placeholders + "Adding 12 photos…" (S3c); skipped files → toast.

S4 Page detail — FR-04, FR-08, FR-11–FR-13
• ONE commit model: everything autosaves; Done (top) returns to the editor. No Apply button.
• Same header on every tab: back, Page x of n, ⋮ (Reset page), Done.
• Crop corners commit on finger-up; pager swipe is disabled on the Crop tab.
• Loupe = cached preview drawn at 2× (no extra render). Handle nudge step = 1% of image.
• Enhance chips = static icons/illustrations, not live renders. Preview ≈1080 px, sliders debounced ~150 ms.
• Apply to all pages = one Room transaction, thumbnails regenerate lazily, Undo snackbar; overwrites brightness/contrast.

s3.text:
S5 Export sheet — FR-14–FR-18, FR-24
• Defaults: Max size = None, Quality = Balanced. Create is always enabled.
• Max size sits above Quality (primary persona's key control). When a size is set: "Folio will lower quality if needed to fit" (target overrides preset).
• Custom → inline number field + KB/MB, 50 KB–50 MB.
• Use ModalBottomSheet + FilterChip in FlowRow; sheet scrolls at 200% font.

S6 Processing — FR-19
• "Page x of n" then "Making it smaller…". System/predictive back = Cancel. Cancel keeps the draft.

S7 Result — FR-18, FR-20–FR-23
• Share is primary. Save → system Save-to picker; snackbar "Saved" (folder name only if the provider exposes it).
• Target missed is never silent. Keeping an over-limit file shows the warning badge (S7c), never a ✓.
• Thumbnail opens the PdfRenderer preview (S7d).

S7e JPG result — FR-24 (P0, D-34)
• One file per page: name_01.jpg… Max size applies per image.
• Share sends all images (ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE). Save to folder uses the system folder picker (OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE).

s4.text:
S8 Settings — FR-34
• Help & FAQ deferred to v1.1 (D-35).
• Standard M3 ListItems. Feedback opens the email app. Licences via AboutLibraries.
• Privacy page Back returns to wherever it was opened from (Home or Settings).

Dialogs — FR-06, FR-23, FR-25
• All are standard M3 AlertDialog / ModalBottomSheet / DropdownMenu.
• Rename: 100-char counter; / : * ? " < > | replaced with _; empty name disables Rename.

All screens: edge-to-edge (targetSdk 35) with explicit insets; check 360 dp width and 200% font; predictive back supported.
